policies.skipped: NOT_CLEAN for required cases; all skips listed
policies.failure_or_error: NOT_CLEAN for any observed case or nonzero suite exit
policies.flaky_or_retried: NOT_CLEAN audit result and explicitly listed, even if original runner exit is zero; do not change configured retry budget
policies.duplicate_required_case: NOT_CLEAN; do not combine overlapping or stale reports

evidence_limits: Module-qualified names are derived from actual source module declarations; Desktop/runtime chains additionally independently confirmed by lifecycle_review.
A clean critical subset is necessary but insufficient for whole suite success; preserve original runner exit and every original suite result.
These tests do not establish full production default owner composition, Agentd process-restart durable coordinator recovery or transparent v2 journal upgrade.
No tests, profiles, timeouts, retries or filters are modified by this manifest or checker.
Source snapshot hashes describe reviewed pre-format integration inputs; exact final candidate provenance belongs to the recorded suite command/tree evidence.

This additive review version includes all immutable original 49 rows and the 10 original e65 message-output regressions. Their 30 assertions remain; final execution hashes must be bound after formatter/lint and the real merge are committed.

The original 59 rows remain unchanged; their historical source_snapshot_sha256 values must not be rewritten in this review manifest. Source binding creates a separate schema-v2 file and preserves those values as review_source_snapshot_sha256.
The 10 additional rows use reviewed input hashes. Formatting or a later merge may change actual source bytes; bind the actual final committed source before auditing its JUnit.

The four final ledger reconciliation tests use the final per-instance cfg(test) write-boundary seam. They do not replace or reclassify the already separate main-stage real-readonly witness RED/GREEN evidence.

The 69-case subset does not prove all seven packages ran. The unfiltered seven-package command, original profile, complete runner result, toolchain, source identity, interval and JUnit hashes remain necessary independent evidence.
No final source SHA, native execution result or qualification result is supplied by this preparation.
Schema v2 source_snapshot_sha256 fields name final committed bytes; review_source_snapshot_sha256 preserves the reviewed v1 bytes. Source binding is not build, lint or test execution evidence.
Default nextest JUnit can omit skipped tests. The required-name gate catches missing required cases, but the original runner summary remains necessary for whole-suite skipped counts.

included_review_manifest.inclusion: All original 49 rows, including names, targets, source review hashes and requirement flags, are retained unchanged as the first 49 entries.

included_history_manifest.inclusion: The first 59 rows are deep-equal to the immutable historical manifest, including all historical source hashes, target aliases and requirement flags.

native_run_requirements.profile: Use the original profile; preserve its configured retries, timeouts and exclusions.
native_run_requirements.selection: Run all seven packages without a required-name expression or any new masking filter. This manifest is only a post-run coverage audit.
native_run_requirements.contracts: No designated required-subset row; the complete codex-hepta-contracts package remains mandatory.
native_run_requirements.candidate: Supply the final tested source commit/tree only after the source is committed. Do not substitute an evidence-only commit or a later source revision.

source_binding.production_source_pin: The full candidate tree, not only the selected test-file hashes.
source_binding.runtime_toolchain: Must be recorded by the real runner; a repository toolchain file is not proof of the invoked executable.
source_binding.scope: A quiescent checkout check, not a concurrent runner or filesystem attestation.
